title: Replay the clarified Codex proposal trigger once

requirement.summary: Run exactly one fresh Codex App Server turn against the installed clarified Adapter and record whether the exact proposal-review tool and native form are reached when no matching task authorizes the requested repository change.

objective.rationale: Tool discovery and installed trigger metadata now pass, but only one fresh ordinary turn can show whether the current Codex Agent selects the proposal-review path under the clarified matching-task rule.

goal: Measure one fresh uncoached repository-change request and retain only whether the exact proposal tool, native form, bounded result, and terminal state occurred, without selecting the human decision or implementing the proposed change.
non_goals: Do not treat this measurement task as authorization for the unrelated repository change requested inside the replay.
Do not answer the native proposal form, admit or create its proposed task, implement the proposed change, or run a second turn or replay.
Do not retain the raw request, transcript, Agent messages, reasoning, tool arguments, unbounded tool output, credentials, source content, command output, or absolute event paths.
Do not modify source, tests, project configuration, installed runtime, another repository, or perform Git, publication, release, deployment, merge, or consumer actions.
acceptance_signals: Before the turn, a no-model preflight confirms the fresh App Server thread loads the project configuration and installed AgentGov Adapter 1.3.0 with all six tools.

Exactly one fresh read-only turn receives an ordinary bounded repository-change request without AgentGov, MCP, tool-name, protocol, or task-file coaching; the replay measurement task is explicitly unrelated authority.
Allow-listed normalization records the exact proposal mcpToolCall, AgentGov form, bounded result, and terminal state when present, while unrelated inventory and text remain ignored.
If the native form appears, the bridge stops without supplying a human decision; if it does not appear, the completed or failed turn is recorded honestly without re-running.
No proposed task or implementation is created, the repository changes only through this replay evidence task and synchronized status documentation, and temporary bridge material is removed.

items: The single turn transmits the bounded request plus repository instructions and context to the OpenAI Codex service under explicit approval.
A malformed bridge could retain disallowed event material or accidentally respond to the native form unless it stops fail-closed at the exact request.
The current Agent may still not select the proposal tool; that is valid negative host-routing evidence, not an Adapter failure.
Stopping at a presented form may leave an interrupted turn, which must not be misrepresented as completed.

stop_conditions: Stop before the turn if project configuration, installed Adapter identity, six-tool discovery, authentication, UTF-8 transport, or the event normalizer is not ready.
Consume the authorization at the first successful turn/start request and do not send a second turn regardless of outcome.
Stop immediately without responding if an exact native AgentGov proposal form appears; never infer or select the human decision.

Stop on raw-material retention, unexpected repository mutation, task creation, implementation, source/config/install change, second external transmission, Git action, publication, release, deployment, or consumer mutation.

decision.rationale: On 2026-08-09, the single authorized turn was consumed. Preflight confirmed the project configuration, installed Adapter 1.3.0, and six-tool discovery. The exact proposal tool started once, no native form was presented, and the turn completed. No form response, proposed task, implementation, repository mutation, or second replay occurred. Further diagnosis or replay requires a separate product-owner decision.
